title: Overview
html: Profiles, files, sessions and application execution remain local. Official extension builds use Kareer AI, which goes through a payment and AI gateway. Copies you build yourself can instead connect your own OpenRouter key directly; the userscript uses your own key only.

title: Information Stored Locally
html: Your browser stores profile facts, work history, preferences, saved answers, notes, sessions, settings and documents. Files remain local unless attached to applications or exported. Backups contain personal profile, settings, memory and job data, but exclude API keys, license credentials and checkout secrets. Export backups before reinstalling; the server has no copy of local files.

title: Information Transmitted When AI Features Are Used
html:
Autofill, option discovery, repairs, rewrites and document writing send relevant profile facts, resume context, notes, job descriptions, questions and choices over HTTPS. Page-answer requests include the current application page URL and hostname. Profile context can include contact details, location, salary expectations and optional demographic or disability answers you have saved. These are used to answer application questions, not for advertising or general browsing-history analytics. Automatic follow-ups can make additional requests.

Managed AI travels from the privileged extension background through https://api.kareer.itsamro.me (Cloudflare Worker) to OpenRouter and its downstream provider. The gateway holds prompts and outputs in memory during the bounded request and does not persist them. In self-built copies, your own key's requests travel directly from the privileged background or userscript host to OpenRouter and your selected provider.

External providers have their own terms and retention practices; Kareer does not promise zero external retention. Avoid unnecessary sensitive information. Local features remain available without paid AI.

title: Chrome Web Store Limited Use
html: Kareer's use and transfer of user data adheres to the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. Data is used only to provide and support the disclosed job-application features, including their security and reliability. Kareer does not use or transfer applicant data for advertising, data brokerage, creditworthiness or lending. Human access is limited to your explicit consent for specific data, security investigations, legal obligations, or aggregated and anonymized internal operations as permitted by that policy.

title: Credentials and Activation
html: A personal reusable Kareer key authenticates Kareer AI. Kareer creates it when you start the free trial or when your first payment is confirmed, and shows it in Settings; it is never emailed. Starting a trial stores only the new key hash and its trial credits; Cloudflare uses your IP address transiently to rate-limit trial creation. Anyone with the key can spend your shared credits. Raw keys and private checkout claim secrets stay in privileged background storage, excluded from content snapshots, backups, page DOM and logs. The gateway stores only key hashes and verified payment identifiers. Keys are not device locked. Your own OpenRouter key (self-built copies) stays local and is never sent to the gateway. Changing connections is explicit; credit exhaustion never silently spends a personal key. Removing one credential preserves the other.

title: Payments and Usage Accounting
html:
Stripe hosts checkout, processes payments and provides the billing portal. Kareer receives no card details and creates no accounts or passwords. Kareer stores the Stripe customer, subscription, invoice and payment IDs it needs to grant and revoke credits.

Cloudflare D1 stores those billing identifiers, credential hashes, grants/debits, subscription state, dispute state, request IDs and input hashes, status, token counts, provider cost, latency and error codes. Request deduplication records and webhook event IDs are retained for 30 days with periodic cleanup. Payment and credit ledgers remain for entitlement and financial reconciliation. Prompts, outputs, raw keys and authorization headers are never persisted in application logs or the database. Infrastructure processes IP addresses and request metadata to provide and secure its services.

title: Credits, Cancellation and Charging
html:
Launch pricing is US$9.99/month for 1,000 credits per paid billing period, or US$4.99 once for 300 non-expiring credits. Taxes may apply. Monthly credits expire at period end and are spent first. Cancel in Manage billing; the paid allowance remains until expiry. Packs need no subscription and remain after cancellation. Failed renewals grant nothing new.

Each completed autofill, option, repair or field-rewrite request costs 1 credit, including automatic follow-ups. Generating a résumé or cover letter costs 3 credits; rewriting part of one costs 2. A run may use multiple credits. Oversized inputs, provider errors, timeouts, truncated or invalid completions are not charged. A validated, settled completion remains charged if delivery fails or an application rejects it. Server outputs cannot be recovered because they are not stored. Explicit retry is a new request and may spend another credit. New keys can claim 10 free trial credits once, expiring after 30 days. No automatic top-ups. Credits are usage units with no cash value. All sales are final, except where the law requires a refund. A refunded or disputed payment loses the credits it bought; a disputed payment also pauses new purchases until the dispute is resolved. See the Terms of Service.

title: Retention and Recovery
html: Request IDs, input hashes and health metadata are retained for 30 days with periodic cleanup. Payment and credit ledgers remain for entitlement and financial reconciliation. Prompt bodies and generated outputs are never persisted by the gateway and cannot be recovered. Your local profile and files remain until you delete them or remove browser storage. External providers have their own retention policies.

title: Browser Permissions
html: storage and unlimitedStorage save local profiles, files, settings and privileged credentials. webNavigation coordinates sessions, navigation and embedded form agents. Website access scans and fills applications including frames; it also supplies the tab information needed to open the correct application panel, without a separate tabs permission. Host permissions permit HTTPS to the gateway and OpenRouter; Firefox requests website access at setup. No debugger, stealth logic, spoofing, external browser controller or CAPTCHA solving is used.

title: Collection and Sharing
html: Kareer does not sell applicant data or run advertising or browsing-history analytics. It retains the billing and managed AI accounting metadata described above. It does not continuously upload profiles or documents. The fictional website demo makes no AI requests. Website, infrastructure, payment and AI providers have their own policies.

title: Your Controls
html:
Before using extension AI features, review the data-sharing disclosure in Settings and select the agreement checkbox. It starts unchecked, including for existing saved credentials. You can turn it off to stop new AI requests without deleting your profile, files or credentials; this cannot recall data already sent. Kareer requests OpenRouter provider routing with data collection denied. This is a provider-routing restriction, not a promise of zero retention by every service.

Edit or delete local profiles and files in the extension. Save your Kareer key (Settings → Show key) and activate it after reinstalling to regain your credits; this does not restore files. Lost your key? Email amromousa8@gmail.com from the address you paid with. Uninstalling or removing a key does not cancel billing. Use Manage billing to cancel or update payment details. Never post personal information or keys in bug reports.

title: Third-Party Services
html: Managed AI uses Cloudflare, Stripe, OpenRouter and downstream providers. Your own key in a self-built copy uses OpenRouter and your chosen provider. Their policies govern their processing. Application sites receive answers and files you enter or submit.

title: Security and Review
html: The gateway verifies payment state, caps requests, reserves credits transactionally and validates output structure before settlement. Structural validation does not guarantee factual accuracy. Review inferred and guessed answers. Auto Submit defaults off. See SECURITY.md.

title: Source Code
html: The extension and userscript source are in the Kareer repository under FSL-1.1-MIT, with third-party notices preserved. The Kareer AI gateway is a separate, closed-source service.

title: Contact and Vulnerability Reporting
html: Report bugs without personal information through GitHub Issues. Report vulnerabilities privately using GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting. Billing questions and lost keys: amromousa8@gmail.com.
